03 / WHAT TO DO NEXT

Keep the conversation going.

01

Check the email

Review the recipient info@hotprint.vn, the details and attachments. If the message is in Outbox or Drafts, check it and finish sending in your email application.

02

Clarify receipt when needed

If receipt is unclear, contact HotPrint by phone, email or Zalo. Identify the request type and sending date to help the conversation.

03

Agree on the next step

Quotations, sample availability and consultations are discussed and confirmed separately. This page does not create an order, appointment or promised response time.
